shortDescription: Create, update, and delete Monitor Logs Streams. A stream defines a flow of logs (like audit logs) to a specific destination.

options.name: destinations
options.description: List of unique identifiers for the sync points that will receive logs data. At the moment only a single destination is supported by the API.

options.name: details
options.description: Additional details for the stream, based on the selected type. Currently, this only applies to streams with a type of ``lke_audit_logs``.

options.name: id
options.description: The ID of the logs stream. Used to identify an existing stream to update or delete.

options.name: label
options.description: The name of the stream. This is used for display purposes in Akamai Cloud Manager.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the logs stream.

options.name: status
options.description: The availability status of the stream. While creating or updating, you can pass ``active`` or ``inactive``. Note that the API might return ``provisioning`` while it is being set up.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of stream. This can be ``audit_logs`` for logs consisting of all of the control plane operations for the services in your Linodes, or ``lke_audit_logs`` for log data for your Linode Kubernetes Engine (LKE) enterprise clusters.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the stream to finish provisioning before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: Time in seconds to wait for the stream to finish provisioning.
